source.name: Skillbook
source.description: Jacob's canonical library of portable Agent Skills.

packages.name: API to CLI
packages.description: Generate agent-first Python CLIs from OpenAPI, Swagger, and AsyncAPI specs: search-first discovery, compact help, trimmed JSON output, and bounded websocket streams.

packages.name: Capture app context
packages.description: Write a repo's operational context: environments, logs, databases, AKS workloads, jobs, and outside systems, confirmed read-only through agent-cli, into docs/app-context.md.

packages.name: Copilot on WSL
packages.description: Install GitHub Copilot CLI and configure it and VS Code Copilot on Windows WSL for full access with no approval prompts.

packages.name: Diagnosing bugs
packages.description: Diagnose hard bugs and regressions: build a fast, red-capable repro loop first, minimise it, test ranked falsifiable hypotheses, then fix at a correct seam with a regression test. Adapted from Matt Pocock's skills.

packages.name: E2E audit
packages.description: Live end-to-end audit: model every state and edge case, test each on real databases, APIs, and the deployed instance, fix defects as found, and clean up tagged test data.

packages.name: Grilling
packages.description: Grill the user on a plan, design, or decision a round at a time, with a recommended answer for every question, until nothing is left assumed. Adapted from Matt Pocock's skills.

packages.name: Herdr
packages.description: Control Herdr, a terminal multiplexer for coding agents.

packages.name: Create agent skills
packages.description: Create, improve, scaffold, and validate reusable agent skills.

packages.name: Email (Proton Mail)
packages.description: Search, read, organize, and draft Jacob's Proton Mail through the home server's Bridge. Never sends.

packages.name: Home server operations
packages.description: Operate the home server: Docker stacks, SOPS secrets, deployments, backups, and recovery.

packages.name: Polish
packages.description: Multi-agent polish pass: a verified plan of small improvements across seven review lenses, then implement approved items.

packages.name: Perf tune
packages.description: Profile-driven performance tuning: ranked speedup plan, then approved changes proven faster by interleaved A/B benchmarks with identical output.

packages.name: Python standards
packages.description: Apply high-integrity Python, Pydantic, typing, pandas, async, uv, Ruff, and ty standards.

packages.name: Python testing
packages.description: Design and review pytest tests, fixtures, and pandas test data.

packages.name: QA analyst
packages.description: Financial-software QA: clarified spec, frozen test plan, parity testing against a reference system in QA, and a sealed, audit-ready evidence pack.

packages.name: Rust TUI
packages.description: Scaffold and extend mouse-first ratatui + crossterm terminal apps: pure state, worker threads, theme tokens, headless replay.

packages.name: Sprint manager
packages.description: Sprint hub over ADO tickets, PRs, and herdr agent tabs: what needs you, ticket drift fixes, next work, and agent kickoffs via agent-cli.

packages.name: To questionnaire
packages.description: Turn questions the user can't answer, such as grilling's parked ones, into a Markdown questionnaire for the person who can. Adapted from Matt Pocock's skills.

packages.name: TypeScript standards
packages.description: Apply strict TypeScript, Angular, ESLint, template, API, async, and runtime-validation standards.

packages.name: Write Diátaxis docs
packages.description: Write and audit technical documentation as tutorials, how-to guides, reference, or explanation.

packages.name: Python house standard
packages.description: Python implementation standards and test design together.
